objective.name: sandbox.reflect.local.meaning
objective.description: Wrapper-backed capacity that reads local meaning through Reflexive and returns a normalized summary.

#root.role: Ask the local Reflexive family for one capacity meaning descriptor and summarize objective and functional sections.

effects.local_reflexive_route: The wrapper performs one local outbound read.meaning request.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local wrapper request becomes a normalized meaning summary after one outbound local Reflexive read.
invariants: sandbox.reflect.local.meaning must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.reflect.local.meaning returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.reflect.local.meaning fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
